data.claim: A trivial change's unit_tests_scope returns the whole suite instead of scoped tests because _ci_not_passed_here's 'no ci gate in this item's pipeline' branch fires before _selectable's trivial branch (ci is excused by TRIVIAL_EXCUSED_GATES)
data.falsifier: unit_tests_scope returns scope 'selected' with 'a trivial change' in why for a comment-only change
data.probe_output: unfixed FAILED whole-suite; fixed PASSED selected
data.question: Why does a trivial change run the whole suite for its unit_tests gate?

evidence.note: research note Ra914afcf25 CONFIRMED: trivial change's unit_tests_scope short-circuits to whole-suite via _ci_not_passed_here 'no ci gate' branch (ci excused) before _selectable's trivial branch; regression test failed whole-suite on unfixed, passed selected on fixed

testscope.py: unit_tests_scope now consults _trivial_or_ci_gap before the whole-suite short-circuit; trivial change falls through to _selectable scoped branch; regression test test_a_trivial_change_runs_the_scoped_tests_not_the_whole_suite added

chunk_findings.detail: `_trivial_or_ci_gap` documents `("", trivial)` whenever there is no whole-suite obligation, but if `_ci_not_passed_here` returns "" (ci already passed on this tree) it returns `("", False)` without calling `_is_trivial`. The same false bit is returned when `failed_sel` or `red` is true. That bit is passed straight through as `trivial=` to `_selectable` and as `ci_excused=`. A comment-only diff whose ci gate has already passed, and no `ci_scope` evidence so `_after_ci` does not return, used to reach `_selectable(..., trivial=True)`; it now reaches `_selectable(..., trivial=False)`, so the "a trivial change" branch is skipped and the selected-scope suffix falls through to the baseline-red / empty wording.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/testscope.py:147

chunk_findings.detail: The new test never reaches `unit_tests_scope`. In this file `run_cli` results are objects with `.data` (the existing glob test uses `out.data.get(...)`), but `test_a_trivial_change_runs_the_scoped_tests_not_the_whole_suite` does `json.loads(_cli_ok(...))`. That raises TypeError on the result object, so the regression the change claims to lock in is not executed.

chunk_findings.detail: The regression test still never reaches `unit_tests_scope`. `_cli_ok` returns the `run_cli` result object (`code, out, err = run_cli(...)`; the sibling assertion in this file uses `out.data`), but `test_a_trivial_change_runs_the_scoped_tests_not_the_whole_suite` does `json.loads(_cli_ok(repo, "--json", "show", "fix-B1"))`. `json.loads` on that object raises TypeError before the comment-only worktree, `_commit`, or `TS.unit_tests_scope` run, so Bfcb327570c is not locked in. The scope change does not fix this call.
